svg.title: Fig. 84(b) — The evolute of y = x⁴ (R₀ = ∞)
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 84(b), page 90. Section: evolutes.

g.data-text: The axes and the quartic y = x⁴, which is flatter than a parabola at O: R0 = ∞.
The evolute (heavy): the centres of curvature of the flat part go off to infinity along the y-axis (two spikes), each half has a cusp, and the arcs beyond the cusps cross the axis.
